description: This file defines the SharedBuffer class within the Thunder::Core namespace, which facilitates inter-process shared memory communication with semaphore-based synchronization. It includes class declarations, constructors, and methods for managing shared buffers, including producer/consumer synchronization, administration data access, and permission management.

classes.name: SharedBuffer
classes.description: A class for sharing data over process boundaries using shared memory and semaphores, supporting producer and consumer roles with synchronization and administration features.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[])
methods.description: Constructor for the consumer role, initializing shared buffer with default size.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[], const uint32_t mode, const uint32_t bufferSize, const uint16_t administrationSize)
methods.description: Constructor for the producer role, setting up shared buffer with specified mode, size, and administration area.

methods.name: RequestProduce
methods.description: Locks the producer semaphore, waiting up to the specified time.

methods.name: Produced
methods.description: Marks data as produced, updating administration and unlocking consumer semaphore.

methods.name: RequestConsume
methods.description: Locks the consumer semaphore, waiting up to the specified time, and realigns buffer.

methods.name: Consumed
methods.description: Marks data as consumed, updating administration and unlocking producer semaphore.

methods.name: AdministrationBuffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the administration buffer.

methods.name: BytesWritten
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes written in the current buffer.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Gets user permissions for the shared buffer.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Gets group permissions for the shared buffer.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Gets permission mode for the shared buffer.
